card.name: Digits and words inside mailing addresses
card.fires_on: Parts of US postal addresses in contact listings, such as the digits of a ZIP+4 code, the hyphen after a ZIP code, "Box" after P.O., or a street name. It marks the point where more address text is expected.

modes.label: ZIP+4 digits
modes.description: Hyphen or digits inside a nine-digit ZIP code after a state abbreviation.

modes.label: P.O. Box and street
modes.description: The word Box after P.O., or a street name before Avenue.

card.writes: It pushes toward address-related text and away from address words such as address, rue and Route.
card.plain: It lights up inside a mailing address, especially in ZIP codes and P.O. Box lines.
